channel.title: Sao Tome and Principe - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sao Tome and Principe, every source cited.

item.title: Príncipe residents face rising crime wave
item.description: Assaults on homes and businesses are causing concern on the island, with residents reporting stolen goods.

item.title: Sao Tome and Principe bans plastic bags
item.description: Law 8/2020 prohibits plastic bag production, import, and sale, with government to create incentives for alternatives.

item.title: Sao Tome and Principe, Angola sign higher education quality deal
item.description: The agreement between ANRES and INAAREES will allow for the exchange of external evaluators and accreditation procedures.

item.title: Sao Tome president sends condolences for Spanish train crash
item.description: Carlos Vila Nova expressed sorrow for the 30 deaths in a collision near Toledo.

item.title: Sao Tome and Principe to get first neurosurgeon in 3 years
item.description: Elyane Neto, 26, returns to Russia for advanced training in a specialty currently unavailable in the nation.
